name: Palm wine
description: Palm sap that begins fermenting the moment it is tapped — sweet in the morning, sour by night.

tcm.note: Outside the classical record; a fresh sap ferment; read as warming.

histamine.note: It ferments in the container as you carry it — one of the few drinks that is measurably higher by evening than by morning.

nutrition.highlight: sweet at dawn, sour by dusk

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. A calabash of it, mild as it tastes fresh-tapped, still delivers enough to produce it — more so by evening as it keeps fermenting in the container. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
